property_summary: For any role that has a non-zero admin Role, calling getRoleAdmin(role) must return a bytes32 value for which hasRole(getRoleAdmin(role), msg.sender) correctly reflects msg.sender's membership in that admin role; the mutant always returns bytes32(0), so for a role with a non-zero admin, hasRole on the returned admin will be false even when msg.sender holds that admin role.
change_summary: Return a constant bytes32 zero instead of the actual admin role.
